# `remote` operations

6 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### remote.list

**Mac workspaces**

List explicitly configured SSH Mac workspaces.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.list
```

### remote.configure

**Connect Mac**

Configure an SSH host alias and absolute directory; authentication stays in SSH.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `host` | string | yes |  |  |
| `directory` | string | yes |  |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.configure '{"name":"<name>","host":"<host>","directory":"<directory>"}'
```

### remote.check

**Check Mac**

Check macOS, Xcode and available Simulator devices through SSH.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.check '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### remote.sync

**Transfer project to Mac**

Sync project files without deleting remote files; exclude credentials and build caches.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.sync '{"name":"<name>","path":"<path>"}'
```

### remote.run

**Run on Mac**

Run an argv array in the configured remote workspace, e.g. xcodebuild or xcrun simctl.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `argv` | array of string | yes |  | 1 to 100 items |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `1800` | 1 to 86400 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.run '{"name":"<name>","argv":["<argv>"]}'
```

### remote.fetch

**Download Mac artifact**

Download a workspace-relative build artifact through SSH/rsync.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `remote_path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |

```sh
tomaccoctl call remote.fetch '{"name":"<name>","remote_path":"<remote_path>","path":"<path>"}'
```
